_doc: The aluminium of 80/20's T-slot profiles, for analysis: "6005A-T61 (or comparable)" in its Product Catalog 24, with 80/20's own strength and modulus (its T-Slot Profile Specifications, given in both inch and metric units). 80/20 gives no density or Poisson's ratio: the density is worked out from its own weight and area for the 1010. Its web shop has listed the same profiles as 6063-T6 with a yield strength of 25,000 psi: check the bar you are sent where strength matters.
name: al6005a-8020

modulus.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-10 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio: 80/20 gives none. Hydro's sheet for 6005A comes to about this from its two moduli; the kit's figure for 6000 series alloys is used
poisson.source: al6005a-t6 rule set (Hydro, Alloy EN AW-6005A); not from 80/20

strength.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-10 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

ultimate.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-10 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

density.rule: Density, worked out from 80/20's own weight over area for the 1010: 0.0424 lb/in over 0.435 in² is 0.0975 lb/in³, 2.70 g/cm³ (anodised, as sold)
density.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)
